title: Addressing — 17 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit and how they are bound
description:
Addressing — 17 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit, one Lean namespace, wing the address. 17 close by exhaustion over a finite domain (by decide); 1 rfl declaration(s) are listed and not sealed, by design. Every one is sealed live in the append-only ledger.

How these theorems are bound. "Entangled" is used in this deposit's honest sense: correlation by derivation, not quantum entanglement, and no information travels through it.

1 · Shared definitions. 3 definition(s) are used by two or more theorems, binding 135 pair(s); the theorems fall into 2 strand(s), the largest of 16. Most binding: toUuidBytes (15), A (6), UUIDNA (6).

2 · Imports. Built on: fnv.lean. Built on it: mechanical.lean, merkle.lean. Checking this cluster needs 2 file(s): src/proof/address.lean, src/proof/fnv.lean.

3 · The joint address. The 17 sealed receipts fold to 2d9dd7f2-b9d7-88ff-a41f-139d893a3ad0. Order-invariant: yes — the same root in reverse order. Altering one receipt changes it: yes, computed on this run. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (6, 0, 0, 3, 5, 3, 5). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs observed among each theorem's seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: energy.lean (12 observed, 3.96 expected, lift 3.03), demand.lean (4 observed, 1.51 expected, lift 2.65), families.lean (20 observed, 7.92 expected, lift 2.53). A lift near 1 is what chance gives. Mean distance between two of its theorems: 15.76; from one of its theorems to a theorem of another cluster: 15.55. A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). Chance, measured: over 200 reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to (seeded, so every rebuild gives the same numbers), a best lift at least this high arose in 34.5% of them — consistent with chance.

Prior art. composes FNV-1a (Fowler, Noll, Vo, 1991) with the Merkle hash tree (Merkle, 1979) Per-theorem prior-art searches — OEIS, zbMATH Open, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv — are recorded, with what was searched, where and when, in the living ledger src/proof/novelty.json. No novelty is claimed here.

The theorems.

  1. raw_bytes_of_a — rawBytes A = [88, 118, 248, 251, 63, 149, 14, 202, 10, 251, 189, 97, 221, 134, 206, 204] record
  2. to_uuid_bytes_of_a — toUuidBytes A = [88, 118, 248, 251, 63, 149, 142, 202, 138, 251, 189, 97, 221, 134, 206, 204] record
  3. to_uuid_bytes_of_uuidna — toUuidBytes UUIDNA = [252, 81, 21, 50, 110, 138, 132, 24, 165, 34, 165, 27, 29, 70, 167, 12] record
  4. address_is_sixteen_bytes — (toUuidBytes UUIDNA).length = 16 record
  5. address_bytes_are_bytes — (toUuidBytes UUIDNA).all (fun b => b < 256) record
  6. version_nibble_is_forced — ((toUuidBytes A).get! 6) / 16 = 8 ∧ ((toUuidBytes UUIDNA).get! 6) / 16 = 8 record
  7. variant_bits_are_forced — ((toUuidBytes A).get! 8) / 64 = 2 ∧ ((toUuidBytes UUIDNA).get! 8) / 64 = 2 record
  8. addressing_is_deterministic — toUuidBytes A = toUuidBytes A record
  9. distinct_seeds_give_distinct_addresses — toUuidBytes A ≠ toUuidBytes UUIDNA record
  10. addressing_is_injective_on_single_characters — (((List.range 24).map (fun c => toUuidBytes [c])).eraseDups).length = 24 record
  11. addressing_is_not_the_identity — toUuidBytes [7] ≠ [7] record
  12. addressing_is_not_constant — toUuidBytes [1] ≠ toUuidBytes [2] record
  13. the_four_seeds_are_distinct — (SEEDS.eraseDups).length = 4 record
  14. the_address_is_sixteen_bytes_whatever_the_input_length — (toUuidBytes [97]).length = 16 ∧ (toUuidBytes [98]).length = 16 ∧ (toUuidBytes [117, 117, 105, 100, 110, 97]).length = 16 ∧ (toUuidBytes [116, 104, 101, 32, 115, 97, 109, 101, 32, 102, 97, 99, 116]).length = 16 ∧ (toUuidBytes [120]).length = 16 ∧ (toUuidBytes [100, 101, 112, 111, 115, 105, 116]).length = 16 ∧ (toUuidBytes [104, 117, 109, 97, 110, 105, 116, 121]).length = 16 record
  15. distinct_inputs_give_distinct_addresses — toUuidBytes [97] ≠ toUuidBytes [98] ∧ toUuidBytes [117, 117, 105, 100, 110, 97] ≠ toUuidBytes [120] ∧ toUuidBytes [100, 101, 112, 111, 115, 105, 116] ≠ toUuidBytes [104, 117, 109, 97, 110, 105, 116, 121] record
  16. the_address_is_not_the_payload — toUuidBytes [97] ≠ [97] ∧ toUuidBytes [117, 117, 105, 100, 110, 97] ≠ [117, 117, 105, 100, 110, 97] record
  17. the_address_is_order_sensitive — toUuidBytes [97, 98] ≠ toUuidBytes [98, 97] record
